# Security

Report vulnerabilities privately through
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/normalengineering/normal/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue.

Include the iOS version, device, and steps to reproduce or a screen recording.
Unverified AI-generated reports will be closed.

Only the latest App Store version is supported.

## In scope
- Unblocking apps, groups or websites without a valid key
- Getting past a block, schedule or daily limit from inside Normal
- Weaknesses in how NFC, QR code / barcode or location keys are checked
- Data leaving the device

## Out of scope
- Bypasses through iOS Settings or Screen Time covered in Normal's FAQ
- iOS and Screen Time bugs, which go to Apple
- Copies of a key you've shared, such as a photo of a QR code or a cloned NFC tag
- Jailbroken devices
